name: cursor-prompt-optimizer
description: Improve a copied prompt with on-demand Semantic Codebase Memory, then one coding-model rewrite. Preview before you replace anything.

chatParticipants.name: optimizer
chatParticipants.description: Rewrite a prompt with Semantic Codebase Memory. One model call, no tools.

promptOptimizer.memory.cliPath.description: Path to the existing codebase-memory-mcp binary. Embeddings and search stay inside that binary; this extension does not create an index.

promptOptimizer.memory.tokenBudget.description: Override memory tokens sent to the model. Leave empty to use the selected profile budget. If the original prompt is long, memory is reduced first; the original request is never truncated.

promptOptimizer.memory.minScoreRatio.description: Drop memory hits whose score is below this fraction of the top score, unless they match an extracted identifier.

promptOptimizer.profile.description: Latency-first generation profile. auto picks simple/normal/complex/large from the local analyzer (no extra model call). Default behavior is Normal.

promptOptimizer.llm.provider.description: vscode uses the editor language-model API (Cursor/VS Code). openai-compatible uses one Chat Completions, Responses, or Messages request. This is not a coding-agent loop: no tools, n=1, no retries.

promptOptimizer.llm.apiStyle.description: chat-completions uses /chat/completions. responses uses /responses. messages uses /messages.

promptOptimizer.llm.baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Used only when provider is openai-compatible.

promptOptimizer.llm.model.description: Model name for the openai-compatible provider. Prefer a small/fast coding model, not the main agent model.

promptOptimizer.llm.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. 0.1 is the latency-first default. Leave sendTemperature off if the provider rejects this field.

promptOptimizer.llm.sendTemperature.description: If false, temperature is omitted from the request instead of assuming the provider accepts it.

promptOptimizer.llm.maxOutputTokens.description: Override max output tokens. Empty uses the profile: simple 600, normal 1200, complex 2000, large 3000. Do not set this below 600.

promptOptimizer.llm.stream.description: Stream the single completion when the API supports SSE. There is still only one request; failed streams are not retried automatically.

promptOptimizer.llm.reasoningEffort.description: Choose effort in the sidebar. Omit by default so unsupported providers are not sent a guessed field.

promptOptimizer.llm.apiKey.description: Optional API key for openai-compatible provider. Prefer the sidebar Save config action, which stores the key in Secret Storage.
